item.title: Three Schuylkill League Athletes Selected for 2025 Mini Max Football Honors
item.description: Three Schuylkill League football players were among those recognized statewide on Wednesday as part of a prestigious academic and athletic honor. Minersville Area’s Dante Carr, Panther Valley’s Brody Breiner, and Tri-Valley’s Cole Gemberling were named 2025 Pennsylvania Mini Max Award winners, as announced by Maxwell Football Club President Mark Dianno. item.title: PennDOT Reduces Speed Limit on Interstate 81 in Schuylkill County Due to Weather
item.description: The Pennsylvania Department of Transportation (PennDOT) has temporarily reduced the speed limit on a stretch of Interstate 81 in Schuylkill County due to hazardous weather conditions. According to PennDOT, the speed limit has been lowered to 55 miles per hour on Interstate 81 between Exit 138 (PA 309 – McAdoo/Tamaqua) and Exit 100 (PA 443 – Pine Grove).
